Prerequisite(s): Channel Energy class feature

Benefit: Choose a metamagic feat you have. As a free action, spend channel energy uses (plus additional uses per level increase of the metamagic feat) to apply that metamagic feat to divine spells you know, without changing the spell's MP cost. Applies only to spells from the class granting channel energy, and only to metamagic feats with a cost equal to or less than your maximum castable spell level (+1 at level 1, +2 at level 4, etc.).
